question: Who won the best actress award (critics) at the South Indian International Movie Awards (SIIMA) 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Aishwarya Rai Bachchan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aishwarya Rai Bachchan** is one of the most accomplished actresses in Indian cinema and has won numerous awards throughout her career.
 
• She is a former **Miss World** (1994) and is globally recognized for her beauty, grace, and acting skills.
 
• She has acted in a variety of films across multiple languages, including **Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, and English.**
 
• Some of her critically acclaimed performances include roles in movies like **Devdas, Guru, Chokher Bali, Raincoat, and Ponniyin Selvan.**
 
• She has also been awarded the **Padma Shri** by the Government of India for her contributions to the arts.
 
• At the **South Indian International Movie Awards (SIIMA) 2024**, she won the **Best Actress Award (Critics)**, highlighting her outstanding performance and dedication to her craft.
 
• SIIMA is a prestigious award ceremony that celebrates the excellence of South Indian cinema and includes categories for Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Malayalam films.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Alia Bhatt**__

 __
 
• **Alia Bhatt** is a leading Bollywood actress known for her versatile performances in films such as **Raazi, Gully Boy, and Gangubai Kathiawadi.**
 
• She has also won several awards, including **Filmfare Awards.**
 
• In recent years, she has expanded her career internationally with her debut in **Hollywood** through the film **Heart of Stone.**
 
 
 
• **Shraddha Kapoor**__
 __
 
• **Shraddha Kapoor** is known for her roles in films like **Aashiqui 2, Ek Villain, and Stree.**
 
• She is popular for her charming screen presence and versatility in playing both romantic and thriller roles.
 
• She is also recognized for her singing abilities and has sung tracks in her movies.
 
 
 
• **Deepika Padukone**__
 
 
• **Deepika Padukone** is a globally acclaimed actress known for her roles in films like **Padmaavat, Bajirao Mastani, and Chennai Express.**
 
• She has won multiple awards, including **Filmfare Awards** and has been named among the **100 most influential people in the world** by Time magazine.
 
• She is also an advocate for mental health awareness and founded the **Live Love Laugh Foundation.**
